sub_graphs.title: Ethereum Execution: Exception Hierarchy
sub_graphs.description: Models the hierarchy of exceptions raised during Ethereum block and transaction processing

nodes.label: Processing Transaction or Block
nodes.description: System is actively processing a transaction or block

nodes.label: Detect Error Condition
nodes.description: System detects a condition that prevents normal processing

nodes.label: Error Condition Detected
nodes.description: An error condition has been identified

nodes.label: Raise EthereumException
nodes.description: Raise base EthereumException or subclass for expected errors during normal operation

nodes.label: Exception Raised
nodes.description: Appropriate exception has been raised and propagates up call stack

nodes.label: Handle Exception
nodes.description: Caller catches and handles the EthereumException

nodes.label: Error Handled
nodes.description: Exception has been caught and appropriate action taken

sub_graphs.title: Ethereum Execution: Block Validation Exceptions
sub_graphs.description: Models exceptions raised during block validation

nodes.label: Block Received for Processing
nodes.description: A block has been received and is being validated

nodes.label: Validate Block
nodes.description: Execute block validation checks

nodes.label: Block Found Invalid
nodes.description: Block failed one or more validation checks

nodes.label: Raise InvalidBlock Exception
nodes.description: Raise InvalidBlock when block being processed is found to be invalid

nodes.label: InvalidBlock Exception Active
nodes.description: InvalidBlock exception has been raised

nodes.label: Reject Block
nodes.description: Block is rejected and not added to chain

nodes.label: Empty Account Detected in State
nodes.description: State contains an empty account (violation)

nodes.label: Raise StateWithEmptyAccount
nodes.description: Raise StateWithEmptyAccount when state has an empty account

external_entities.name: P2P Peer Node
external_entities.description: Peer node sending blocks for validation

sub_graphs.title: Ethereum Execution: Transaction Validation Exceptions
sub_graphs.description: Models exceptions raised during transaction validation

nodes.label: Transaction Received
nodes.description: Transaction received for processing

nodes.label: Validate Transaction
nodes.description: Execute transaction validation checks

nodes.label: Transaction Invalid
nodes.description: Transaction failed validation

nodes.label: Raise InvalidTransaction
nodes.description: Raise InvalidTransaction when transaction is found to be invalid

nodes.label: Invalid Sender Detected
nodes.description: Transaction sender lacks authorization

nodes.label: Raise InvalidSenderError
nodes.description: Raise when account lacks transaction authorization

nodes.label: Invalid Signature Detected
nodes.description: Transaction signature verification failed

nodes.label: Raise InvalidSignatureError
nodes.description: Raise when transaction has an invalid signature

nodes.label: Transaction Rejected
nodes.description: Transaction has been rejected due to validation failure

external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
external_entities.description: External entity submitting transactions (user or application)

sub_graphs.title: Ethereum Execution: Gas and Balance Exceptions
sub_graphs.description: Models exceptions related to gas and balance validation

nodes.label: Transaction Gas Check
nodes.description: Checking transaction gas parameters

nodes.label: Check Intrinsic Gas Coverage
nodes.description: Verify transaction provides enough gas for intrinsic cost

nodes.label: Insufficient Intrinsic Gas
nodes.description: Transaction gas does not cover intrinsic cost

nodes.label: Raise InsufficientTransactionGasError
nodes.description: Raise when transaction does not provide enough gas for intrinsic cost

nodes.label: Check Block Gas Limit
nodes.description: Verify gas consumption does not exceed block gas limit

nodes.label: Gas Exceeds Block Limit
nodes.description: Cumulative gas usage exceeds block gas limit

nodes.label: Raise GasUsedExceedsLimitError
nodes.description: Raise when gas consumption surpasses block availability

nodes.label: Check Sender Balance
nodes.description: Verify sender has sufficient funds for transaction

nodes.label: Insufficient Balance
nodes.description: Sender lacks sufficient funds

nodes.label: Raise InsufficientBalanceError
nodes.description: Raise when sender cannot cover transaction cost

nodes.label: Gas and Balance Valid
nodes.description: Transaction passes gas and balance checks

sub_graphs.title: Ethereum Execution: Nonce Validation Exceptions
sub_graphs.description: Models exceptions related to nonce validation and overflow

nodes.label: Checking Transaction Nonce
nodes.description: Validating transaction nonce against expected value

nodes.label: Compare TX Nonce with Expected
nodes.description: Compare transaction nonce with sender's expected next nonce

nodes.label: Nonce Mismatch
nodes.description: Transaction nonce does not match expected sender nonce

nodes.label: Raise NonceMismatchError
nodes.description: Raise when transaction nonce does not match expected nonce for sender

nodes.label: Check Nonce Overflow
nodes.description: Verify nonce does not exceed maximum value (2^64 - 2)

nodes.label: Nonce Overflow
nodes.description: Transaction nonce exceeds 2^64 - 2

nodes.label: Raise NonceOverflowError
nodes.description: Raise when transaction nonce is greater than 2^64 - 2

nodes.label: Nonce Valid
nodes.description: Transaction nonce is valid

ambiguities.text: InvalidSenderError description says 'originates from accounts lacking transaction authorization' but does not specify what 'authorization' means
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume authorization refers to: valid EOA with correct signature, not a contract (for most tx types), and potentially EIP-7702 authorization for delegated execution.

ambiguities.text: EthereumException is described as base class for exceptions 'expected to be thrown during normal operation' - unclear boundary between expected and unexpected
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'expected' means validation failures that can occur with malformed/malicious input, not internal implementation bugs or resource exhaustion.

implicit_assumptions.description: All exception types in the hierarchy are the only error conditions that can occur during transaction/block processing
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Unhandled exception types could crash nodes or cause undefined behavior during edge cases.

implicit_assumptions.description: Exception messages and types do not leak sensitive information about node state to potential attackers
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Error messages could be used for fingerprinting, timing attacks, or revealing internal state.

implicit_assumptions.description: The nonce overflow check at 2^64 - 2 is sufficient to prevent all nonce-related attacks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Edge cases around the nonce boundary could enable replay attacks or transaction ordering manipulation.
